text: Economic Development and Culture (EDC) staff will provide an overview of three key strategic plans being developed for City Council’s consideration in 2024: the Economic Development and Culture (EDC) Divisional Strategy, the Action Plan for Toronto’s Culture Sector, and the Action Plan for Toronto’s Economy. The presentation will include an outline of engagement frameworks and the opportunity for the committee to provide early feedback in the strategy development processes.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received the item for information.
